title: 第九章 完美筑基第十章 山门骄徒
content_zh:
一山高耸，拔地而起，俯瞰下方茫茫村镇与连绵山野。
此地远离市井喧嚣，峰顶平整开阔，无林木遮蔽，无鸟兽惊扰，夜风清朗，灵气安稳适中，是附近方圆十里最适宜闭关突破的僻静之地。
烬孤宸离开药斋之后，并未在镇中多做停留。
避开长街往来的修士行人，孤身穿镇而出，一路直行，登临这座无名孤峰。
夕阳垂落，余晖染红天际，晚风徐徐，拂动破旧麻衣。
他立在崖边，俯视下方烟火人间。
青岚镇繁华依旧，街巷人流往来不息，低阶修士争逐资源、计较得失，凡人奔波劳碌、困于生计。
众生皆困樊笼，或困于富贵贫贱，或困于修为境界，或困于天道规则。
唯他欲破笼而出，以身证道，独创唯一。
掌心轻翻，刚购入的筑基资材一一悬浮而出。
三株翠绿筑基草，叶脉凝露，灵气内敛；两朵凝气花，花瓣莹白，灵韵绵长；十枚浑圆淬气丹丹香醇厚，药力凝练；五包洗髓散粉末细腻，净脉伐浊。
全套筑基资源，品相上乘，灵气充盈，足以支撑一场安稳筑基。
但烬孤宸所求，从不止于安稳破境。
他要的，是无瑕道基，完美筑基。
寻常低阶修士，急于突破境界，草草炼化丹药灵草，勉强冲破炼气壁垒，凝成筑基道台。这般筑基，速成却留瑕，道台虚浮、经脉藏浊、根基残缺，日后修行桎梏重重，终生难以踏足高处。
诸天亿万修士，九成皆败于根基浅薄。
前路上限，从筑基那一刻，便已锁死。
烬孤宸心神漠然，古井无波。
他的道，无缺、无瑕、无漏、无拘。
自凡尘苦修起步，万灵归一，杂质尽去，炼气境打磨极致圆满，今日筑基，亦要碾压古今同阶，铸就万古无瑕道根。

席地而坐，端正身姿，背脊笔直如松。
晚风穿身，不动不摇，双目闭合，心神彻底沉寂，斩断世间一切杂念纷扰。
首先开启的，是洗髓伐脉。
撕开纸包，细腻洁白的洗髓散尽数落于掌心。
道源残烬微热，淡淡吞噬道韵铺开，瞬间将洗髓散药力提纯归一。
无半分驳杂药毒，无半分多余药性。
精纯药力顺着周身八万四千毛孔缓缓渗入皮肉肌理，游走四肢百骸，冲刷每一条细微经脉，涤荡沉积多年的尘埃淤浊。
自小饥寒疾苦、外伤暗疾、凡尘浊气，尽数被药力温柔冲刷、剥离、排出体外。
体表渗出薄薄一层灰黑污渍，是肉身残留的最后凡尘杂质。
他神色始终平静，任凭药力碾轧经脉、重塑肌理，无半点痛楚动容。
多年绝境求生，早已淬炼出万古不动的磐石道心。
半个时辰后，洗髓伐脉落幕。
肉身通透无瑕，经脉宽阔柔韧，澄澈干净如全新玉管，再无一丝凡尘淤堵。
此刻身躯，已是纯粹修行道体，不染凡俗半分尘埃。
紧接着，烬孤宸依次取过筑基草、凝气花。
灵草入体，无需咀嚼，无需炼化口诀。
道源之力自生净化，草木灵机化作潺潺灵流，温和绵长，层层滋养气海，温润丹田壁垒。
content_en:
A towering mountain rises from the ground, overlooking the vast villages, towns and rolling mountains below.
This place is far away from the hustle and bustle of the city. The peak is flat and open, with no trees to cover it, no birds and beasts to disturb it, the night breeze is clear, and the spiritual energy is stable and moderate. It is the most suitable secluded place within a ten-mile radius for retreat and breakthrough.
After Jin Guchen left the medicine studio, he didn't stay much in the town.
Avoiding the monks and pedestrians walking on the long street, walked out of the town alone, walked straight all the way, and climbed to this unknown solitary peak.
The sun sets, the afterglow dyes the sky red, and the evening breeze blows the shabby linen clothes.
He stood on the edge of the cliff, looking down at the fireworks below.
Qinglan Town is still prosperous, with a constant flow of people in the streets and alleys. Low-level monks compete for resources and care about gains and losses, while ordinary people are busy working and struggling to make ends meet.
All living beings are trapped in cages, either in wealth or poverty, in the realm of cultivation, or in the rules of heaven.
He is the only one who wants to break out of the cage, prove the Tao with his own body, and create the only one.
He flipped his palm lightly, and the foundation-building materials he just purchased floated out one by one.
Three emerald-green foundation-building grasses, with dew-condensed leaves and restrained aura; two Qi-condensing flowers, with white petals and long-lasting aura; ten round Qi-quenching elixirs with mellow fragrance and concentrated medicinal power; five packs of marrow-washing powder with fine powder, which can cleanse the pulse and remove turbidity.
A complete set of foundation building resources, high quality and full of spiritual energy, enough to support a stable foundation building.
But Jin Guchen never wanted more than a stable and broken situation.
What he wants is a flawless Dao foundation and a perfect foundation.
Ordinary low-level monks, eager to break through the realm, hastily refined elixirs and spiritual herbs, barely broke through the Qi refining barrier, and formed a foundation-building Taoist platform. This kind of foundation building is accomplished quickly but leaves flaws. The Taoist platform is empty, the meridians are turbid, and the foundation is incomplete. In the future, there will be many shackles on practice, and it will be difficult to reach high places throughout life.
Ninety percent of the hundreds of millions of monks in the world are defeated because of their shallow foundation.
The upper limit of the road ahead has been locked from the moment the foundation was established.
Jin Guchen's mind was indifferent, and there was no wave in the ancient well.
His way is flawless, flawless, flawless, and unrestricted.
Since the beginning of hard work in the mortal world, all spirits have been unified, all impurities have been removed, and the Qi refining realm has been polished to perfection. Today's foundation building will also crush the same level in ancient and modern times, and create a flawless Taoist root for all eternity.
Sit on the floor with your body upright and your back as straight as a pine tree.
The evening wind penetrates the body, motionless, eyes closed, mind completely silent, cutting off all distracting thoughts in the world.
The first thing to start is to cleanse the marrow and cut off the pulse.
Tear open the paper package, and all the fine and white washed marrow falls into the palm of your hand.
The remnants of the Daoyuan are slightly hot, and they spread out the Tao Yun lightly, instantly purifying the power of the Marrow Washing Powder.
There is no trace of miscellaneous medicinal poisons, and no trace of redundant medicinal properties.
The pure medicinal power slowly penetrates into the skin texture along the 84,000 pores all over the body, travels through the limbs and bones, washes away every tiny meridian, and cleans away the dust and turbidity accumulated for many years.
Since childhood, I have suffered from hunger, cold, trauma, hidden diseases, and turbid odors from the world, all of which have been gently washed away, peeled off, and expelled from the body by the power of the medicine.
A thin layer of gray-black stains oozed from the body surface, which were the last mortal impurities left in the flesh.
His expression was always calm, and he allowed the power of the medicine to crush his meridians and reshape his texture without any pain on his face.
After many years of surviving in desperate situations, he has already tempered his Taoist heart that will never change.
Half an hour later, the marrow cleansing and pulse cutting came to an end.
The physical body is transparent and flawless, the meridians are wide and flexible, as clear and clean as a brand new jade tube, and there is no trace of mundane clogging.
At this moment, the body is a pure Taoist body, not stained by the dust of the world.
Immediately afterwards, Jin Guchen took the Foundation Building Grass and Qi Condensing Flower in turn.
The spiritual grass enters the body without chewing or refining formulas.
The power of the Tao source is self-generated and purified, and the inspiration of the vegetation turns into a gurgling spiritual current, which is gentle and long, nourishing the sea of ​​Qi layer by layer, and warming the Dantian barrier.
